author: Project Underdog
applies_to: Any StatsBomb open-data competition with 360 frames released AFTER the lock date (e.g. FIFA World Cup 2026). Not used in building the rules.
outcome: net xG = own non-penalty xG minus opponent xG in the 20 s after the decision
success_criterion: Count & Strike is supported if at least 5 of 6 predictions hold (correct sign with one-sided p < 0.05 AND estimate inside the predicted range).

predictions.rule: COUNT: each extra opponent behind the ball at a regain lowers counter xG
STRIKE: in the box, central, <=3 ahead, pressed -> shoot beats lateral pass
STRIKE: edge of box, central, 4-6 ahead, pressed -> shoot beats lateral pass
STRIKE: edge of box, central, packed (7+), pressed -> shoot beats lateral pass
STRIKE (weak): 25-40 yds, central, packed, pressed -> shoot beats lateral pass
predictions.baseline: +0.015 (se 0.002); teams choose the shot only 20% of the time

predictions.rule: RUN: attacking third (wide left), free, <=3 ahead -> carry forward beats dribble

cell_code: 5 digits: x-zone (0 own third .. 5 in box), y-zone (0 left,1 central,2 right), opponents ahead (0 <=3,1 4-6,2 7+), nearest opponent (0 <3yd,1 3-7,2 >7), teammates ahead (0 0-1,1 2-3,2 4+)
